classification: period-evidence-bounded distributed RC reconstruction; not a surviving-panel measurement
reconstructionRule: DMG geometry and timing take priority. Missing pristine-panel electrical quantities are bounded by contemporary production data and comparable LCD-driver specifications, then propagated through a distributed electrical model. No aged DMG specimen is used to identify pristine parameters.

derivedPixelElectricalBounds.decision: LC ohmic leakage is retained in the solver, but the period conservative floor proves it negligible for one 36.241 us grayscale dwell. Ionic retention remains WS4, not WS5 crosstalk.

ensembles.basis: lowest sourced ITO anchor, lower comparable driver bound, largest WS2 cell gap, and epsilon_perpendicular
standard 10 ohm/square ITO construction, directly specified period-driver maximum, WS2 nominal 6 um gap, and geometric mean of orientation extrema
1988 high-side ITO production result, all-output comparable driver bound, smallest WS2 cell gap, and epsilon_parallel

declaredLimits: No LH5076 or LH5077 analogue datasheet has been recovered; comparable period LCD-driver resistance is an ensemble constraint, not a Nintendo part identification.
No DMG electrode mask dimensions have been measured; the BGB idealized fill fraction bounds line width and is reported as geometry-dominated uncertainty.
The solver uses a first-order superposition of two distributed electrode networks. It reports the product of row and column fractional errors as an omitted second-order coupling bound.
Aged surviving-panel photographs may validate sign and visible plausibility only; they cannot select pristine electrical inputs.
